anti_overlap: fd-dimension-construct-validity covers whether individual dimensions are internally valid constructs
fd-llm-judge-reliability covers how LLMs interpret dimensions during scoring
fd-reference-relative-scoring covers whether comparing to a human reference is the right paradigm
decision_lens: Prioritizes gaps where a pillar that shapes the product's training data and constitution has zero corresponding signal in the eval rubric.
focus: Mapping coverage gaps between the 7 editorial pillars and the 6 eval dimensions
name: fd-pillar-dimension-gap
persona: A product quality architect who specializes in ensuring evaluation frameworks stay aligned with product-defined quality criteria.
review_areas: Map each of the 7 pillars to the closest eval dimension(s) and flag pillars with no coverage
Assess whether de_aiisms has any proxy in the eval dimensions
Check whether specificity (concrete language, evidence over assertion) maps to any dimension
Assess whether cadence (rhythm, sentence length variation) is captured
Examine whether preservation is meaningfully different from fidelity + tonal_match combined
Determine whether the eval would pass an edit that strips AI-isms and adds specificity but diverges from the reference
success_hints: Every product pillar should have at least one corresponding eval signal
The eval should not reward reference-similarity at the cost of pillar-relevant quality
task_context: The eval scoring module uses 6 dimensions to judge a model's line-edit against a human editor reference on a 1-10 scale. The product's editorial identity is defined by 7 pillars but these are not directly used as eval dimensions.
